name: Plan a restorative rest window
short_description: Choose a feasible sleep or rest window and protect it from avoidable interruptions for seven days.
self_assessment: I can plan and protect one rest window each day for seven days without help.
description: Choose a feasible sleep or rest window and protect it from avoidable interruptions for seven days. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Set a consistent seven-day sleep opportunity
